851 Fenimore Rd, Mamaroneck, NY 10543

The National Kidney Foundation (NKF) Golf Classic at Winged Foot Golf Club, presented by Collins Building Services, Inc., is one of the nation’s premier amateur charity golf events and a distinguished platform for client entertainment and relationship-building. This exclusive outing offers an unparalleled opportunity to host clients, strengthen business connections, and enjoy a memorable day on one of the country’s most renowned golf courses, all while supporting a meaningful cause. Participants will also have the chance to qualify for the National Finals, taking place January 14–17, 2027, at Pebble Beach Resorts.
Designed to combine world-class golf with elevated hospitality and networking, the event delivers an exceptional experience both on and off the course. Teams may compete in either the Handicap Index Division or the Gross Division, allowing for a day that is both competitive and enjoyable for golfers of all levels.
In the Handicap Index Division, each team may include one player with a handicap index of 8.0 or lower, and the combined handicap index for all four players must be at least 42.0. The Gross Division is designed for teams without an official USGA Handicap Index or those who do not meet the Handicap Index Division criteria.
We are proud to return to Winged Foot Golf Club, an iconic venue that hosted the 2020 U.S. Open and will host again in 2028. With its legendary courses, exceptional service, and world-class amenities, Winged Foot provides an unforgettable experience rooted in tradition and excellence — making it the ideal setting to entertain valued clients, engage top executives, and support the fight against kidney disease.

Kenneth J. Collins
President and CEO,
Collins Building Services, Inc.

Outstanding Leadership & Philanthropy Award
Kenneth J. Collins has been a steadfast champion of the National Kidney Foundation Golf Classic at Winged Foot for more than a decade. His unwavering commitment has not only elevated this event, but has also helped drive critical advancements in kidney research, fuel innovation, and expand life-changing care for patients and families across the kidney community. Learn more about CBS.

acceptedAnswer.text: National Kidney Foundation (EIN: 13-1673104) is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization and your donation is tax-deductible within the guidelines of U.S. law. To claim a donation as a deduction on your U.S. taxes, please keep your email donation receipt as your official record. We'll send it to you upon successful completion of your donation.

mainEntity.name: Is there a minimum amount I'm allowed to give?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every dollar counts. No gift is too small and makes a meaningful difference in our work to advance research, diagnosis and treatment of kidney disease.

mainEntity.name: Will I receive a donation receipt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A donation receipt will be sent to you at the email address you provide on this form. Please be sure to keep a copy of your receipt for tax purposes. We’ll also make a statement of your generosity available for download in your Account whenever you need it. Can’t find it? Contact: Donations@kidney.org.

Your support helps us do more. More research, more advocacy, more transplants, more hope. Your generosity will ensure that NKF can continue to make transplants a priority through research, innovation and advocacy, while expanding access to programs that help patients find their perfect match.

mainEntity.name: Can I make my gift by mail or over the phone?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Of course! Complete our mail-in donation form to accompany your offline donation and send it to:

Attn: Gift Processing at National Kidney Foundation HQ
30 East 33rd Street
New York, NY 10016

Or, call us to complete your gift at 212-889-2210
If you are experiencing any issues or have questions about your contribution, please contact donations@kidney.org.
